name: Aha Ω
ability: Each day, the player that the Storyteller thinks is the funniest might get a boon.
flavor: The Masked Fools share a parable about the Aeon: When Aha climbed to the highest branch of the Imaginary Tree, THEY saw the void, the stars operating like machinery, and how meaning bows before nothingness. THEY continued looking until THEY saw a baby fall to the ground and cry. THEY burst into laughter so clear it tore through the universe and still reverberates to this day.

name: Archivist Ω
ability: Each night, choose two players (not yourself): learn which player's character goes first alphabetically.
flavor: These records are impeccably kept. The answer you seek will be here.
firstNightReminder: The Archivist chooses 2 players. :reminder: :reminder: Show them the player who goes first alphabetically.
otherNightReminder: The Archivist chooses 2 players. :reminder: :reminder: Show them the player who goes first alphabetically.

name: Emperor Ω
ability: If you were mad that you were not the Emperor, you can't die.
flavor: Any man who must say "I am the King" is no true king.

name: Hawkmoth Ω
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. You start by choosing a good player: they become evil & gain a character ability of your choice. You may be told to reconsider. If this happens 3 times, the Storyteller chooses. [-1 Minion]
flavor: This is just the beginning, Ladybug. You and Cat Noir may have won this battle, but I will win the war.
firstNightReminder: The Hawkmoth chooses a player & a character. :reminder: If it ruins the balance of the game, shake your head and ask again. If this happens 3 times, shake your head and show a character token. Put the Hawkmoth to sleep. Wake the chosen player. Show them the *YOU ARE* info token. Give a thumbs down.

name: Prince Ω
ability: 1 player starts knowing you are the Prince. If an evil player nominates & executes you, a good player becomes the Prince.
flavor: This is my father's land to rule over! How dare these damned demons try take what has been destined to be mine!
firstNightReminder: Wake the player marked *KNOW*. Show the *THIS PLAYER IS* & Prince tokens.
otherNightReminder: If the Prince was nominated and executed by an evil player, wake a good player. Show the *YOU ARE* info token and a Prince token.

name: Songstress Ω
ability: Each night, choose any number of players: if all are your alignment, they are sober & healthy until dusk. An opposing player, if chosen, might learn who you are.
flavor: How beautiful! My beautiful melodies have touched that hearts of Ravenswood Bluff. May you rejoice forever in song and dance.
firstNightReminder: The Songstress chooses any number of players. :reminder: If an opposing player was chosen, you may mark them. :reminder: Put the Songstress to sleep. If marked, wake the player marked *KNOW*. Show the *THIS PLAYER IS* & Songstress tokens.
otherNightReminder: The Songstress chooses any number of players. :reminder: If an opposing player was chosen, you may mark them. :reminder: Put the Songstress to sleep. If marked, wake the player marked *KNOW*. Show the *THIS PLAYER IS* & Songstress tokens.
